Seam joins a Mac and a Windows PC on your local network: one keyboard and mouse, a shared clipboard, Mac audio on the PC, and windows in both directions.

## New in 3.0

- **Seam Pro.** Keyboard, mouse and text in the clipboard stay free. Mac audio on the PC, windows in both directions and images in the clipboard are Pro: a one-time $10 at [seamdesk.app](https://seamdesk.app), with a 7-day free trial and no account. One license or trial on either computer unlocks Pro for the pair; a key works on up to 3 computers.
- **English first**, with a full Polish translation and a language setting (Settings → General).
- **Windows apps on the Mac** each become their own Mac app with a Dock icon, Cmd+Tab entry and menu bar name; **Mac windows on the PC** through a virtual monitor.
- New look on both platforms: colored pages, glass cards and a separate Settings window.

## Download

- **macOS 14.2+** (Apple Silicon and Intel): `Seam-macOS.zip`
- **Windows 10/11 x64**: `Seam-Windows-x64.exe`

On first launch macOS may ask you to choose **Open Anyway** in System Settings → Privacy & Security, and Windows SmartScreen may show "Unknown publisher" → **More info → Run anyway**. Don't turn Gatekeeper or SmartScreen off globally. Every update is checked with SHA-256 and a pinned ECDSA signature before it installs.
